options.title: Pizza Hut Built Red Roofs. Domino's Built an App
options.first_line: Pizza Hut built thousands of red-roof restaurants. Domino's built for your front door instead.
options.first_frame: A red-roofed Pizza Hut restaurant pushing in at dusk, the Pizza Hut logo dropping in beside it.

options.title: Pizza Hut Had {fact1} of America's Pizza. Then Domino's Came
options.first_line: In 2015 Pizza Hut sold {fact1} of America's pizza, more than Domino's.
options.first_frame: A pizza box opening on a kitchen table, a Pizza Hut logo on its lid, the share on a label beside it.

options.title: Domino's Was Second to Pizza Hut. Not Anymore
options.first_line: Domino's was America's number two pizza chain, behind Pizza Hut's red roofs.
options.first_frame: A Domino's delivery car parked outside a red-roofed Pizza Hut, a stamp NO. 2 landing on the car.

why: A pizza box you've opened yourself with Pizza Hut's share on it, and 'Then Domino's came' asks how the leader lost without giving the answer, while A and C already say who won.
